subject: website
name: Orivon Status
summary: Orivon's page that checks, from the visitor's own browser, whether its sites, names and releases are served right now. Open source (AGPL-3.0-only), served as written, no third-party code. It stays at 3 because its answers come from servers: ENS names from public Ethereum RPC endpoints with no light client, releases from the GitHub API. IPFS blocks from public gateways are hash-checked in the page. Orivon's grant dialog names all eight hosts, and each sees the visitor's IP address.

operations.name: Check that a site, name or release is served
operations.note: Name records come from Ethereum RPC endpoints and release data from GitHub; neither is checked against a trustless source.

operations.name: Verify a fetched block against its address
operations.note: The hash is computed in the page.

connections.name: Public Ethereum RPC endpoints (ENS)
connections.note: publicnode, drpc and mevblocker answer; no light client checks them.

connections.name: Public IPFS gateways and the routing service
connections.note: Blocks and signed IPNS records are checked in the page. The gateways see the visitor's IP address.

connections.name: api.github.com (pins and releases)
connections.note: A backend API read as sent.
